I have never been afraid of Black people. I wasn't raised to be that way. But I do know WW that were raised to think AAs were a threat. And all of the racist stereotypes in America, reinforced that belief. 

#BlackLivesMatter

I don't say this to attack all white men, please don't @ me. I just want WW to see that they aren't threatened by some "outsider".

Implicit bias is in ALL of us, no matter our skin tone. It hides deep inside & erupts when we feel threatened. No one is immune.

#BlackLivesMatter
